messages:
Iris: Quick sync on the autoscale card updates I pushed — goal: keep list compact but surface burst + guardrails without extra height. Prototype: https://figma.redwood/autoscale-compact-v3 :sparkles: Tom: Love compacting min/max into a single "target" chip by default. Concern: discoverability for power users. Maybe show a subtle chevron and title attr for screen readers. Jo: Accessibility: when collapsing to target, ensure `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` are set. Also add an offscreen label: `span.sr-only` that reads the hidden min/max when focused. Ravi: Burst visibility idea: show a small burst badge next to pool name (green dot + "burst") that opens a popover on click. Popover has amount + policy and a big Disable button. Keeps card tidy. Maya: Copy nit: badge hover text should read "Temporary burst enabled: handles short spikes; billed at burst rate." Also change label from "Burst" to "Temporary burst" across the UI for consistency. Iris: UX call: should SLO slider presets live in the card or only inside the modal? Product asked for quick chips in card for common presets (Low-latency / Balanced / Cost-saving). They should apply with a tiny toast and undo. Tom: If presets apply guardrails that dramatically change limits, show a concise inline confirmation: "Applying Cost-saving disables burst and reduces max to X. Undo". Don't block flow but be explicit. Jo: For screen readers, announce preset changes via `role="status" aria-live="polite"` so users hear the impact. Also ensure the toast is focusable with a skip link. Ravi: Performance note: cost calc is async. Debounce input updates to 300ms, cancel inflight, and show spinner in the cost chip. Use aria-live="polite" on the chip for updates. Example snippet I shared: `
$0.12/hr
` Maya: Keyboard flow proposal: pool -> burst badge (enter opens popover) -> target -> expand -> min -> max -> presets -> save. Add visible focus ring, and tooltips must show on focus too. Iris: Great feedback. I'll update the figma with the badge variant, target collapse behavior, preset chips + undo toast, and include a11y annotations. Will ping when ready for review. :+1:
